resources.string: Drag a row away from the start side. Past 42 % of the strip it stays open; a tap on the row closes it. The switches keep their own drag.
No rows left. Restore them below.
The same row with revealEdge = END and an accent action. The second row was opened from code.
Tap a header. The body grows from its top edge and the chevron turns with it.
Only the height of the body changes. The text stays anchored at its top edge and is clipped at the bottom, as if a cover slid away.
Tap again while the section is moving and it turns around from where it is. Nothing fades and nothing scales.
With the header focused, Enter or Space toggles the section. A screen reader hears whether it is expanded or collapsed.
The row that slides aside for Delete is extracted from the original app. The end edge, the tones and icons of the action and the expandable section are new in Mallet.
